column1: # One row per CDX query. Read by build/harvest.py; lines starting # are comments.
# mode      prefix = one matchType=prefix request; paged = walk CDX index pages, one cached file per page;
#           months = one prefix request per upload month of the period, {month} in the prefix (Drupal YYYY-MM folders);
#           hub = the documents an agency's COVID page and the pages under it linked to, on the agency's own site
# filters   CDX filter= terms, separated by ;  (applied by the server, before collapse)
# dated     yes = from=201912&to=202305 on the request; no = the host's captures start after the period
#           (the archives.gov mirrors began in 2021), so the date has to come from the URL or a lookup
# select    all = every row; keywords = only rows whose last path segment matches harvest.KEYWORDS
# status    harvested / partial / retry come from the Cowork survey and run by default;
#           queued and blocked run only when named with --source
# HANDOFF counts are what the Cowork survey reported (22-25 Oct 2026), kept to check the re-run against.
